results.target: 10M+ lines under 15 minutes and under 8 GB peak memory
results.achieved: largest run that fits this machine: 241,162 lines in 13.0s, peak 2.64 GB on AMD64 (Windows), 13.8 GB RAM, 5.2 GB available at start; slowest stages: exports 3.3s, sensitivity 3.2s, ingest classify waterfall reconcile 3.1s, segmentation 1.9s. KNOWN GAP: the 10M-line target could not be verified on this hardware (next rung 450x700 projected ~5.3 GB peak, over the 4.2 GB budget on this machine); the pipeline's memory use is linear in lines across the measured rungs, but that is an extrapolation, not a measurement.

phase35_before_after.note: Phase 35 scale refactor, measured at the 300x500 rung (241,162 lines) on the same machine. 'bytes_per_line_peak' divides the whole process peak (including the ~1.3 GB Python + libraries + allocator floor) by lines; 'bytes_per_line_marginal' is the slope between the two measured rungs, i.e. the engine's actual per-line growth. Before numbers are the Run 4 ladder (real-data validation then ran inside the default pipeline; it is now behind --validate, and the ladder measures the default run).
